chunks: Whilst when they measure or weigh for them, give less.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about giving short measure in trade?
ai.summary: This verse, often cited in Shia jurisprudence (fiqh) regarding commercial transactions, underscores the moral corruption of those who cheat in trade by giving short measure. It reflects the broader Quranic theme of divine retribution for dishonesty, linking economic integrity to spiritual accountability. The phrase 'يُخْسِرُونَ' (they lose) implies both a loss of divine favor and a tangible deficit in their own spiritual and material accounts.
